thread:
zoe: Solaris asked for a short POC playbook: model variants, cost sketch, security answers, and a timeline. Need by EOD tomorrow.

solaris_contact: Use case: support ticket triage + automated summaries. Expected 8-12 rps, ~2k token sessions. P95 target ~200ms. Data has PII; redaction + KMS required. Hosted ok for pilot.

kai: Quick plan: two variants — open-13b-fp16 for low-latency hosted route, open-13b-quant-4bit for cost-efficient batch/dedicated. KV caching recommended.

hana: KMS noted. Will prepare a security one-pager (SOC2, KMS integrations AWS/GCP, access logs, retention). Also confirm US key residency if requested.

matt: Infra note: to hit P95 <200ms we must keep low-latency batching small (batch=2-4). That increases cost; dedicated pool gives predictability. VPC transition ~2-3 weeks.

ana: Legal: I'll draft a KMS addendum + DPA clauses and flag subprocessors. Need dataflow diagram from sales.

kai: Pilot config (sketch):
```
routes:
  low_latency: open-13b-fp16, batch=2, max_seq=2048
  throughput: open-13b-quant-4bit, batch=24, kv_cache=true
fallback: prefer_fp16_then_quant
estimate: "~$3.0/token-unit fp16, $0.8/token-unit quant (rough)"
```

zoe: Action items for EOD tomorrow:
- kai: pricing triad (trial, monthly reserved, 12mo commit) + pilot timeline
- hana: security one-pager + questionnaire answers
- ana: KMS addendum draft
- matt: infra checklist for hosted -> dedicated/VPC and latency tradeoffs
- zoe: compile playbook and send to Solaris

oncall-bot: Playbook ticket created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/1809876543 :white_check_mark:

solaris_contact: Thanks — we'll review once you send. Happy to jump on a 20m sync after.

zoe: Will schedule follow-up after upload. Thanks team :pray:
